title: A community of scholars
text: The Museum is also a part of the royal palaces; it has a public walk, an Exedra with seats, and a large house, in which is the common mess-hall of the men of learning who share the Museum. This group of men not only hold property in common, but also have a priest in charge of the Museum, who formerly was appointed by the kings, but is now appointed by Caesar.
source: Strabo, Geography 17.1.8 · H. L. Jones translation (1932) · https://penelope.uchicago.edu/Thayer/E/Roman/Texts/Strabo/17A1*.html
